  PROBLEM: The fragment says each workflow makes "one `GET branches/promote-candidate` read per run", but the code makes one read per resolve step: 21 call sites across 13 workflows, with several reads in one job (orchestrate_poll.yml, implement.yml, clarify.yml, plan.yml, orchestrate.yml); only validate.yml shares the result between its steps, through `promote_candidate_sha` / `promote_candidate_checked`.
  WHY: The shipped code does not fail at runtime, but readers would undercount API reads and would believe that steps in one pinned run cannot read different tips or reach different protected/unprotected decisions, which is false; all reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low); suggested fix: reword to "one read per resolve step (only `validate.yml` shares the result between its two steps)".
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "P1.3: `validate.yml` (around line 138, `ghr_ref=main` for this repo, and the resolver step around lines 188-195). On the exact promote-candidate ref with a protected branch, use its tip SHA for both checkouts; otherwise use main as today."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/validate.yml, "Bootstrap GitHub API retry helper" step, line 138 (`if [ "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" = "shubhodeep1/coding-workflows" ]; then ghr_ref=main; fi`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff changes the resolver and support-files fetch steps but not the bootstrap checkout step, which still sets ghr_ref=main and has no promote-candidate case, so on a `@promote-candidate` run it still clones `main`. "Resolve integration ref" (line 198-222) and "Fetch workflow support files" do follow the branch. The deviation is recorded in `changelog.d/promote-candidate-support-ref.md` and `agents.d/7746-promote-candidate-support-ref.md` because `tests/test_workflow_gh_retry_fallback_contract.py:435` requires this step to be byte-identical, and one copy is in `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml`, outside files_touched. The step stages only `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` / `emit_event.sh`. Severities differ: gemini BLOCKER, luna MAJOR, minimax NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus call this an accepted, deferred residual.
- requirement: P1.1 requires the matching workflows to "call `gh_retry gh api repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/promote-candidate`."
  expected_change_site: The promote-candidate lookup in `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml`, including its fallback behavior around lines 43–46.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The lookup calls `gh_api_retry`, but `cancel_on_pr_close.yml` has no retry-helper bootstrap. Its inline fallback runs plain `gh api` once, and `|| true` hides a failed request, so a transient lookup failure falls back to `github.sha` without the required retry. Rated MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus say the gh_retry vs gh_api_retry difference was declined or deferred in earlier rounds, as the fail-open behavior follows the issue's Security section.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- agents.d/7746-promote-candidate-support-ref.md:line 2, "do they make one `GET branches/promote-candidate` read per run (in `validate.yml`, "Fetch workflow support files" reuses the result of "Resolve integration ref" ...)" | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documented "one read per run" does not match the code: a grep finds 21 `branches/promote-candidate` reads across 13 files. `implement.yml` has 4 (duplicate-notice step, `pr_not_open_support_ref`, main support-ref step, heal-report job), `orchestrate_poll.yml` has 2 ("Resolve workflow support ref for gh retry" and the main resolve step, both in the poll job), and `clarify.yml`, `plan.yml` and `orchestrate.yml` have 2 each. Only `validate.yml` passes the SHA between steps, through `promote_candidate_sha` / `promote_candidate_checked`.
  WHY: The code is not affected, but in orchestrate_poll the gh-retry step and the main support step can read different tips, or disagree on protected/unprotected when one read fails (mixed-source staging). Phase 2/3 planning or API-budget accounting based on this text would undercount reads. Fix: reword to "one read per resolve step (only `validate.yml` shares the result between its two steps; other workflows with several resolve steps, such as `implement` and `orchestrate_poll`, read it once per step)". Also listed as a hardening suggestion, about 1 line changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Verified (not a finding): when there is no tracking issue, "Resolve integration ref" exits at line 185, before the promote-candidate block (lines 204-222), so "Fetch workflow support files" reads the branch itself, which matches the fragment.
- Not re-raised: the P1.3 `ghr_ref=main` bootstrap in validate.yml (accepted as deferred; byte-identical requirement in `tests/test_workflow_gh_retry_fallback_contract.py`; the `security-audit.yml` copy is outside files_touched) and the P1.1 `gh_retry` vs `gh_api_retry` difference (declined earlier; both fail open).
